edges.reason: msg.sender is written into owner in the Owned constructor, establishing the privileged account.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership can execute.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, an attacker-controllable check.
transfer debits and credits balances keyed by msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
transferOwnership reads owner through the onlyOwner modifier.
acceptOwnership reads owner to emit OwnershipTransferred and rewrite it.
acceptOwnership reads and then clears newOwner.
